items.question: What mastery of the sixfold piercing establishes someone as the true guru?
premises: The piercing is characterized as sixfold.
A person is identified as the performer of that piercing.
Such a performer is declared to be the guru.
items.inference: Mastery of the sixfold piercing qualifies a person to be recognized as the guru.
uncertainties: The specific nature of the sixfold piercing is not detailed in this verse.
items.plain_english: O goddess, he who is the performer of the sixfold piercing is indeed the guru.

items.question: Whose capacity to purify the six paths defines the true guru?
premises: A person is described as able to purify the six paths.
This person is explicitly identified by the text.
That person is declared to be the guru.
items.inference: The ability to purify the six paths is a defining qualification of the guru.
uncertainties: The specific six paths are not enumerated in this verse.
items.plain_english: O beloved, he who can purify the six paths is declared to be the guru.
